mapper.select: SELECT t.*, u.name AS requester_name, u.major AS requester_major, u.avatar_url AS requester_avatar_url, u.score AS requester_score, u.points AS requester_points, helper.id AS helper_id, helper.name AS helper_name, helper.major AS helper_major, helper.avatar_url AS helper_avatar_url, helper.score AS helper_score, helper.points AS helper_points, COALESCE(tc.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN users u ON t.requester_id = u.id LEFT JOIN task_participants helper_tp ON helper_tp.task_id = t.id AND helper_tp.role = 'helper' AND helper_tp.status != 'canceled' LEFT JOIN users helper ON helper_tp.participant_id = helper.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT task_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM task_comments GROUP BY task_id ) tc ON tc.task_id = t.id WHERE t.id = #{id}

SELECT t.*, u.name AS requester_name, u.major AS requester_major, u.avatar_url AS requester_avatar_url, u.score AS requester_score, u.points AS requester_points, helper.id AS helper_id, helper.name AS helper_name, helper.major AS helper_major, helper.avatar_url AS helper_avatar_url, helper.score AS helper_score, helper.points AS helper_points, COALESCE(tc.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN users u ON t.requester_id = u.id LEFT JOIN task_participants helper_tp ON helper_tp.task_id = t.id AND helper_tp.role = 'helper' AND helper_tp.status != 'canceled' LEFT JOIN users helper ON helper_tp.participant_id = helper.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT task_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM task_comments GROUP BY task_id ) tc ON tc.task_id = t.id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT t.*, u.name AS requester_name, u.major AS requester_major, u.avatar_url AS requester_avatar_url, u.score AS requester_score, u.points AS requester_points, helper.id AS helper_id, helper.name AS helper_name, helper.major AS helper_major, helper.avatar_url AS helper_avatar_url, helper.score AS helper_score, helper.points AS helper_points, COALESCE(tc.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN users u ON t.requester_id = u.id LEFT JOIN task_participants helper_tp ON helper_tp.task_id = t.id AND helper_tp.role = 'helper' AND helper_tp.status != 'canceled' LEFT JOIN users helper ON helper_tp.participant_id = helper.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT task_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM task_comments GROUP BY task_id ) tc ON tc.task_id = t.id WHERE t.requester_id = #{requesterId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT t.*, u.name AS requester_name, u.major AS requester_major, u.avatar_url AS requester_avatar_url, u.score AS requester_score, u.points AS requester_points, helper.id AS helper_id, helper.name AS helper_name, helper.major AS helper_major, helper.avatar_url AS helper_avatar_url, helper.score AS helper_score, helper.points AS helper_points, COALESCE(tc.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count FROM tasks t INNER JOIN task_participants tp ON tp.task_id = t.id LEFT JOIN users u ON t.requester_id = u.id LEFT JOIN task_participants helper_tp ON helper_tp.task_id = t.id AND helper_tp.role = 'helper' AND helper_tp.status != 'canceled' LEFT JOIN users helper ON helper_tp.participant_id = helper.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT task_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM task_comments GROUP BY task_id ) tc ON tc.task_id = t.id WHERE tp.participant_id = #{helperId} AND tp.role = 'helper' AND tp.status != 'canceled' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT t.*, u.name AS requester_name, u.major AS requester_major, u.avatar_url AS requester_avatar_url, u.score AS requester_score, u.points AS requester_points, helper.id AS helper_id, helper.name AS helper_name, helper.major AS helper_major, helper.avatar_url AS helper_avatar_url, helper.score AS helper_score, helper.points AS helper_points, COALESCE(tc.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN users u ON t.requester_id = u.id LEFT JOIN task_participants helper_tp ON helper_tp.task_id = t.id AND helper_tp.role = 'helper' AND helper_tp.status != 'canceled' LEFT JOIN users helper ON helper_tp.participant_id = helper.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT task_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM task_comments GROUP BY task_id ) tc ON tc.task_id = t.id WHERE t.status = #{status} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT t.*, u.name AS requester_name, u.major AS requester_major, u.avatar_url AS requester_avatar_url, u.score AS requester_score, u.points AS requester_points, helper.id AS helper_id, helper.name AS helper_name, helper.major AS helper_major, helper.avatar_url AS helper_avatar_url, helper.score AS helper_score, helper.points AS helper_points, COALESCE(tc.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN users u ON t.requester_id = u.id LEFT JOIN task_participants helper_tp ON helper_tp.task_id = t.id AND helper_tp.role = 'helper' AND helper_tp.status != 'canceled' LEFT JOIN users helper ON helper_tp.participant_id = helper.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT task_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM task_comments GROUP BY task_id ) tc ON tc.task_id = t.id ORDER BY CASE t.review_status WHEN 'pending_review' THEN 0 WHEN 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t.created_at DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(like_count), 0) FROM tasks WHERE requester_id = #{requesterId} AND task_mode = 'topic'
SELECT review_status AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tasks GROUP BY review_status
SELECT COALESCE(category, '未分类') AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tasks WHERE review_status = 'approved' GROUP BY category ORDER BY value DESC, label ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at >= #{start} AND completed_at < #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY label ASC
